questions.question: In the summary, what does the phrase "short-covering" mean?
options: Buying stocks to close a short position
Holding stocks for a long time
Selling stocks to open a short position
questions.explain_en: Short‑covering is when traders who previously sold stocks short buy them back to close the position.
questions.explain_zh: 「short‑covering」指的是先做空股票的投資人買回股票，以平倉結束部位。
